name: blade-language
description: Live diagnostics, type hovers and lenses, go-to-definition/rename, deduction pinning, notebooks, and REPL-style evaluation for the Blade DSL (.blade / .edgi)

scripts.test: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/repl.js && node --check src/serve.js && node --check src/notebook.js && node --check src/plots.js && node --check src/builtins.js && node --check src/types.js && node --check src/keywords.js && node --check scripts/vscode-mock.js && node --check scripts/provider-test.js && node --check scripts/notebook-test.js && node --check scripts/plots-test.js && node --check scripts/check-consistency.js && node --check scripts/repl-protocol-test.js && node --check scripts/serve-protocol-test.js && node --check scripts/nav-integration-test.js && node --check scripts/notebook-eval-test.js && node --check scripts/fetch-vendor.js && node scripts/check-consistency.js && node scripts/provider-test.js && node scripts/notebook-test.js && node scripts/plots-test.js

blade.compilerPath.description: Path to Blade.exe. Leave empty to pick the most recently built of the common build locations (Release/Debug), then 'Blade' on PATH. Used by diagnostics, hovers, and all run/eval commands.

blade.checkOnSave.description: Run 'Blade check' on save and report diagnostics.

blade.checkOnOpen.description: Run 'Blade check' when a Blade file is opened.

blade.runTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for 'Blade run' invocations (compile + execute; first runs invoke g++).

blade.inlineReplResults.description: Show each REPL evaluation's result inline at the end of the evaluated line (green value / red error; full output and timing on hover). Cleared when the document changes.

blade.liveChecking.description: Check the file as you type (fast tier: parse + typecheck + deduce, no monomorphization) via a persistent 'blade ide serve' process. Only takes effect when the compiler supports 'ide serve'; older compilers are unaffected and keep checking on save/open only. Turning this off disables the as-you-type clock but leaves checkOnSave/checkOnOpen behavior unchanged.

blade.fastCheckDebounceMs.description: Milliseconds of typing inactivity before a fast (as-you-type) check is sent to 'blade ide serve'. Only applies when blade.liveChecking is on and the compiler supports 'ide serve'.

blade.fullCheckIdleMs.description: Milliseconds of no further edits after a successful fast check before a full check (fast tier plus monomorphization, upgrading hover/lens types to concrete instantiations) runs automatically. Full checks always also run on save and open, regardless of this setting.

blade.signatureLens.functions.description: Show an Ionide-style abstract signature lens above each function/lambda binding (e.g. 'name : T1 -> T2 -> Ret').

blade.signatureLens.arrays.description: Show an index-arrow signature lens above each array-typed value binding (e.g. 'a : Idx<3> -> Float64').

blade.deductionLens.description: Show a clickable lens above functions/kernels with a deduced-but-unpinned comm/anticomm clause (e.g. 'deduced comm(a, b) · symmetric storage — pin'); clicking inserts the pin.
